text: K2 has a carving error, so K4 may too. The experiment took the copper with one letter deleted or one inserted, at every place: 196 versions, 48 of them different where the known letters sit.
On each version it ran the exact two-word test: two secret words used in turn on the table, every pair of lengths up to a total of 22, every pair of tables built from puzzle words.
914 survivors at totals 21 and 22 on the copper, 878 on a shuffled copper run the same way: chance. No one-letter slip lets two short words explain the known letters.
